content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding us exists anywhere in this agreement. The only relevant provisions run in our favor.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or competitive field-of-use restriction on Mortgage Logic.com (Client), so the rule sits at the preferred position. Section 2(a) goes further in our favour by expressly confirming that Client is not obligated to use the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other system to provide software and services similar to TrueLink's (subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and the Section 10 confidentiality obligations per p0024), and the license itself is non-exclusive. Section 8's covenants on Client are limited to legal compliance, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access controls, content warranties and anti-spamming — none restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The only "Non-Competition Agreement" reference (p0054) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licensed use of Credit Data, i.e., a restriction on the counterparty, which the rule expressly treats as acceptable; we note it is a separate instrument not reviewed here, and its terms should be confirmed to contain no reciprocal restraint on Client, but nothing in this document creates one. No redline required.
